ABOUT KLEZA

Where artificial intelligence meets human intention — that’s where Kleza builds the future.

A healthcare-first AI and digital services company, operating across the USA and India since 2016.

Scroll to explore
WHO WE ARE

We built Kleza because small businesses deserved the same AI advantage as the enterprises that could afford it.

Kleza was founded in 2016 with a single conviction: that true progress comes from getting the balance right between technology and human expertise. Not AI as a replacement for people — AI as a precision instrument in the hands of people who know what they’re doing.

Today, 75% of our work is in healthcare — an industry where the stakes of getting AI wrong are higher than almost anywhere else. We serve home care agencies, hospitals, pharmacies, and health-tech companies across the USA, with a delivery team of 40+ specialists operating from Hyderabad, India.

We are Kleza Solutions — and our product is the intelligence, the engineering, and the human care that powers the work of caring for others.

With Kleza, you’re not choosing a service. You’re choosing a smarter way to grow.

OUR VISION

AI is not the future of healthcare. AI plus human judgment is.

01

Precision over generalisation

Generic AI gives generic answers. Every system Kleza builds is trained on domain-specific data — producing outputs that earn clinical trust rather than demanding it.

02

Humans in the loop, always

No Kleza AI system operates without human oversight. We design escalation paths, review cycles, and quality checks into every deployment — because technology that replaces human judgment in healthcare is a risk, not a feature.

03

Intelligence that improves over time

We build AI that learns from operational reality — models that get more accurate as your data evolves, not systems that decay after deployment.

“

The most powerful technology in healthcare is not the one that replaces the caregiver. It is the one that makes the caregiver more capable.

HEALTHCARE INNOVATION

75% healthcare. 100% intentional.

Healthcare is not a vertical we entered for market size. It is the industry where the need for intelligent, reliable, human-centred technology is most acute — and where the consequences of poor technology are most serious.

Our healthcare clients include home care agencies, long-term care facilities, pharmacies, staffing organisations, and health-tech companies. We understand their regulatory environment, their staffing challenges, their documentation burden, and the human cost of getting any of it wrong.

MILESTONES

How we got here.

2016

Founded

Kleza Solutions established in Hyderabad with a focus on digital services for small and mid-size businesses.

2018

USA Expansion

Opened operations in Overland Park, Kansas, extending service delivery across North American time zones.

2020

Healthcare Pivot

First major healthcare client engagements. Began building domain expertise in home care and long-term care operations.

2022

IVNA Launch

Launched IVNA.ai, our dedicated AI products platform, starting with Voica AI and the Pulse Board.

2024

AI Services Expansion

Launched Business-Specific AI Training and AI Support Assistant as standalone service lines.

2026

Full Ecosystem

Kleza operates as an integrated ecosystem: AI Products (IVNA.ai) + AI Services + Enterprise Services across USA and India.
